solution.what: Read both Founders texts; 12 Nov fully decoded; [22 Nov] has 12 unread and 6 conjectured groups.
Tested the Pinckney legation code and Armstrong's THE=972 code on the open groups.
LoC Burr Conspiracy Collection: not digitised (microfilm 17,112); finding aid behind a bot check.
Found sibling Graham 2 Jan 1806 decoded with the State Department code printed in Weber 1979 pp. 419-30.
Weber 1979 is a print-disabled loan; table layout seen in search-inside only (73/74 near present/president); a bulk sweep was stopped and not used.

outcome.method_basis: No key and no images reached; the editors' partial decode stands.
